name: EKS Blue-Green Deployment Strategy
summary: Implement a blue-green deployment strategy in AWS EKS to minimize downtime and ensure seamless application updates.
description: This project focuses on implementing a blue-green deployment strategy within the AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) environment. The primary goal is to minimize downtime during application updates and ensure a seamless transition between application versions. The blue-green deployment approach allows for two identical environments: one (blue) running the current application version and the other (green) hosting the new version. By switching traffic from blue to green, we can ensure that the new version is functioning correctly before fully committing to it. This strategy not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces the risk of downtime and rollback issues. The project will involve setting up the necessary infrastructure, configuring Kubernetes resources, and automating the deployment process to facilitate smooth transitions. Additionally, we will provide documentation and training to ensure your team can manage future deployments effectively.

name: EKS Pod Autoscaling Optimization
summary: Configure horizontal and vertical pod autoscaling in AWS EKS to dynamically adjust resources based on workload demands.
description: The EKS Pod Autoscaling Optimization project aims to enhance the performance and efficiency of your applications running on AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) by implementing both horizontal and vertical pod autoscaling. This process involves analyzing your current workload patterns and resource usage to determine the optimal scaling configurations. Horizontal pod autoscaling will allow your application to scale out by adding more pods in response to increased demand, while vertical pod autoscaling will enable the adjustment of resource limits and requests for existing pods based on their performance metrics. By automating these scaling processes, we ensure that your applications maintain high availability and performance while optimizing resource utilization and cost. This project will include a thorough assessment of your current EKS setup, configuration of the necessary Kubernetes resources, and comprehensive testing to validate the autoscaling functionality. The end goal is to provide a robust autoscaling solution that adapts to your workload demands seamlessly.
